content.gameplay_tips:
## Early Game
Focus on farming minions and jungle camps until you get your first items. Consort Yu scales with attack speed, and with no attack speed early on, she can struggle. Use Skill 1 Oak Bolt to last-hit minions and poke the enemy at a safe range. Skill 2 Protecting Winds will save your life more than you think. Save it for when the enemy markman want to commit or for enemy jungle ganks.

## Teamfights
In teamfights, stay behind your frontline and hit the first enemy in front of you. Don't use Skill 2 too early; instead, save it for when the enemy is looking to dive onto you. Keep moving and repositioning in fights; your slows from your passive help you kite well in teamfights. Consort Yu's ultimate Vaulting Shot is a great chasing tool to stun enemies but can also be used to escape danger, so use it wisely.

## Tips & Tricks
Use Consort Yu's passive to attack and kite enemies
Try to bait enemies in when you have Skill 2 up to surprise them and kill them in a 1 vs 1
Consort Yu's Ultimate is best used as a reposition tool if you get jumped on by enemies

Consort Yu is a strong Farm Marksman who wants to close distance on a chosen target and stick to them. Public guide data shows a build centered on Boots of Dexterity, Eternity Blade, Twinblades of Destruction, used to farm the safe side, scale into late game, and protect priority targets. Pick her when the draft lets Consort Yu reach targets that aren't built around Luna-style answers; avoid when the enemy chains crowd control that stops the engage before damage lands.

Public build references for Consort Yu recommend Boots of Dexterity, Eternity Blade, Twinblades of Destruction, Shadow Ripper, Bloodsoul, and Mortal Punisher. Use this as the baseline marksman plan before adapting to the enemy draft.

Spare options listed in build data include Cloud Piercer, Daybreaker's Virtue, Deepfrost Siege, and Bloodweeper. Treat these as situational swaps when the default path is not enough — for example, swapping in defensive items against burst comps or penetration items against stacked armor.
Luna and Diaochan are flagged in counter data as a direct answer to Consort Yu. Bait the enemy crowd control before engaging, and route through fog to reach targets without being seen first.
Reliable hard control stops Consort Yu's engage before the combo lands. Bait the most threatening control skill before committing Vaulting Shot, and wait for ally engage to absorb peel.
Public synergy data lists Donghuang and Daji as strong partners for Consort Yu. Plan engages around Donghuang's setup window, then second-engage with Vaulting Shot.

A girl at one with the forces of nature, innocent and beautiful. Every arrow from her bow radiates the blessings of the forest. Acting upon her master's orders, she embarked on a journey to explore the world around her, and in the process, fell in love with the heroic Xiang Yu. However, she was warned by her senior, Liang, that the person she had fallen in love with was the dark master from the prophecies. Brokenhearted and resigned to her fate, Consort Yu's arrow had already tragically pierced her lover's heart when the illusion of the being disguised as Liang wore off. How will this fateful love tragedy end, and what should the despairing Consort Yu do?
Source: Official Honor of Kings — canonical lore for Consort Yu.

Consort Yu's recommended core build is Boots of Dexterity, Eternity Blade, Twinblades of Destruction, and Shadow Ripper. Round out the build with Bloodsoul and Mortal Punisher based on the matchup. Check the Build section above for the full item order.

Public counter data lists Luna and Diaochan as direct answers to Consort Yu, because they have the crowd control or peel to interrupt the engage before damage lands. The Matchups sidebar shows the current source-tracked list.
Consort Yu's Chinese name is 虞姬 (CN server). On the international server, the hero is called Consort Yu. The kit and abilities are identical — only the name differs across regions.
Consort Yu pairs best with Donghuang and Daji according to public synergy data. These supports provide the peel and setup Consort Yu needs to scale safely through the early game.

Consort Yu sits at A-tier because extended team fights reward sustained DPS, exactly what Consort Yu delivers when protected. Recent patch notes (Stat Changes) reinforce her performance in the current meta. See the Tier List for the full ranking context.

Consort Yu scales into late-game team fights once core items come online. The full build (Twinblades of Destruction, Shadow Ripper, and Bloodsoul) brings sustained DPS that compounds in extended fights. Avoid forcing early commits — the win condition is reaching the late game intact.
